headline: Area yard prices hold steady
detail: Big Daddy and Central Metal postings are unchanged, and Alsip-area averages for heavy steel and sheet iron stayed near 9 cents a pound through Oct 20. The national index last showed clean copper grades down 8 cents, with aluminum and ferrous flat.

headline: Copper stuck in a tight range
detail: LME copper edged up to about $14,540 and COMEX gained about half a percent to $6.61. Chile disruptions cut BHP's quarterly copper output 19% and Anglo's 5%, but buyers are cautious at these prices.

headline: Still no call on refined copper tariffs
detail: The White House has not ruled on tariffs for refined copper and is focused on affordability before the midterms. The US keeps importing anyway, pushing COMEX stocks to a record of about 718,000 tons.

headline: Housing data come in weak
detail: September housing starts fell 5.2% and pending home sales dropped 7.3% to the lowest on record, with builder confidence at 29. That is a soft sign for rebar, structural steel and copper wire demand.

headline: GM beats and raises cash guidance
detail: GM earned $4.1 billion on an adjusted basis in Q3, up 22%, led by North American trucks, and raised its free cash flow outlook. Steady Detroit output keeps busheling and other prime scrap flowing.

headline: Gold slips for a third day ahead of Fed
detail: Gold fell about 0.4% to near $4,124 even as yields and the dollar eased. Markets see a hold at the Oct 27-28 Fed meeting but over 90% odds of a December hike.

headline: Oil whipsaws on Gulf attacks and talks hopes
detail: Brent hit about $112 after attacks on Gulf shipping and Saudi energy sites, then settled near $109 on reports of efforts to revive US-Iran talks. High energy costs keep inflation and rate worries alive.

headline: Palladium sinks again, platinum and silver up
detail: Palladium fell about 1.4% to near $1,086, close to a one-year low, while platinum rose about 0.7% and rhodium held at $9,100. Converter values stay soft.

headline: Nickel jumps in Shanghai on output-cut talk
detail: Shanghai nickel rose 2.4% Wednesday morning as news of production cuts sent short sellers running. LME aluminum slipped about half a percent to $3,003 and zinc fell about 1%.

headline: US steel high, iron ore near lows
detail: Midwest hot-rolled coil held near $1,363 a ton, close to a three-and-a-half-year high. Iron ore sits near $91, around its lowest since 2024, as Chinese mill margins stay thin.

headline: China steel output flat, copper buying firm
detail: China made 73.6 million tons of crude steel in September, flat on the year and down 2.9% year to date. A copper scrap shortage there pushed the Yangshan import premium to its highest in almost four years.
